sections.title: About Equal AI and Services:
sections.body: Equal Identity Private Limited, a company incorporated under Companies Act, 2013 provides Equal AI which is a digital personal assistant designed to answer phone calls on your behalf as your agent and assist in the conversation to help you decide how to respond or follow up. Equal AI is intended for use and service within India.

sections.title: 2. AI Assistant Functionality and Limitations
sections.body:
a. You are solely responsible for how you use the Assistant, including any decisions, actions, or communications made through it. We act only as your agent and on your behalf and are trained solely by instructions given by you and/or information fed by you. We shall not be liable for any consequences arising from the Assistant’s interactions, such as accepting delivery instructions, disclosing sensitive personal information, or any miscommunication during calls. Users must exercise discretion and are expected to review and monitor the Assistant’s outputs, as we do not guarantee the accuracy, appropriateness, or legal compliance of its responses.

b. The Assistant does not verify or authenticate the identity, legitimacy, or intent of any caller interacting with the Assistant. The Assistant engages with callers based solely on the information/ instructions given by you followed by information presented during the call and does not conduct any form of background verification or identity validation. By using the service, you acknowledge and accept that you assume all risk associated with such interactions given the limited role played by us as your agent, and we shall not be held liable for any loss, damage, misrepresentation, or harm resulting from reliance on or engagement with any caller through the Assistant.

c. We use AI models to interpret unknown calls and may generate summaries or suggested responses. However, the Assistant may inaccurately interpret caller intent, tone, or context. You are responsible for reviewing AI-generated outputs by the Assistant before acting upon them. We do not guarantee the accuracy or reliability of the Assistant’s responses and shall not be liable for any consequences arising from such interpretations.

d. We shall not be liable for any unintentional access to, disclosure of, or reliance upon sensitive personal information communicated to or by the Assistant during any interaction, including voice calls, where such disclosure results from unclear instructions, ambiguous context, or misinterpretation of user input. Users acknowledge and agree that they are solely responsible for the nature and content of information shared during their use of the Assistant, and shall exercise all reasonable caution to avoid inadvertent disclosure of confidential, personal, or sensitive personal information.

e. Due to the nature of our services, we may not be able to directly notify third-party callers that their communication is being handled by an AI agent or may be recorded/ transcribed. You acknowledge and accept this limitation and agree that you will use the Assistant responsibly in compliance with applicable data protection laws, and as mentioned above, agree and acknowledge to bear sole liability and responsibility in relation to any calls which are taken by the Assistant.

f. Equal AI is not designed or intended for use in emergency situations. Do not rely on Equal AI to handle emergency calls. You are responsible for making direct emergency communication through traditional methods.

g. Equal AI uses AI models that generate responses and take actions based on information given by you or information received from the caller and places reliance on context, behavioural patterns, and predefined logic trees. You acknowledge and accept that such responses or actions may not always accurately reflect your intent, may contain errors, or may lead to unintended outcomes. Given the limited role played by us as your agent, by using the Assistant, you waive any claims against us for irreversible actions taken by the system including but not limited to declining or ending calls, providing dismissive or inaccurate responses, or relaying incorrect information and agree that we shall bear no liability for any direct or indirect consequences arising therefrom.

h. We shall not be liable for any transactions initiated, rejected, delayed, or influenced by the responses or actions of the Assistant. This includes, but is not limited to, any financial loss, business disruption, missed opportunities, contractual disputes, or misunderstandings arising from reliance on the Assistant’s outputs. Users are solely responsible for verifying information and making independent decisions, and we disclaim all liability for any direct or indirect consequences resulting from such interactions.

i. We shall not be liable for any disclosure, misuse, or loss of sensitive personal information that is unintentionally shared with or by the Assistant during a call, including instances arising from unclear commands, ambiguous context, or misinterpretation by the Assistant. Users are solely responsible for ensuring that no confidential or sensitive personal information is disclosed inadvertently and must exercise caution while interacting with the Assistant. Any personal information that you share with us will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 3. Payments, Subscriptions and Refunds
sections.body:
For Android Users:

Certain features of the Assistant, including access to conversation history, live transcripts, and audio playback (“Paid Features”), are made available only upon payment. Paid Features may be offered as one-time unlocks at specified touchpoints within the Assistant and/or as recurring subscription plans, in each case as described at the point of purchase. The specific Paid Features, their scope, and their applicable price will be displayed to you within the Assistant before you complete any purchase.

All prices are listed in Indian Rupees and are inclusive of applicable Goods and Services Tax (GST). The price displayed to you at the point of purchase is the binding price for that transaction. You acknowledge and agree that prices may vary between users and across touchpoints, including on the basis of promotional offers, discounts, time-limited campaigns, geographic factors, or product experiments, and that another user may be offered a different price for the same or a similar Paid Feature. Any discount or saving displayed to you is referenced against our standard listed price for the relevant Paid Feature. We reserve the right to modify pricing at any time, with any revised price applying only to transactions initiated after such modification.

All payments are processed through Razorpay (Razorpay Software Private Limited), a payment aggregator authorised by the Reserve Bank of India. By making a payment, you authorise us to charge your selected payment method through Razorpay. Your use of Razorpay’s services is additionally governed by Razorpay’s own terms and conditions
and privacy policy, and we request you to please read Razorpay’s terms and conditions available at https://razorpay.com/terms/ and its privacy policy at https://razorpay.com/privacy/ before making a payment. We do not collect, store, or process your complete card number, CVV, UPI PIN, or net-banking credentials; these are handled exclusively by Razorpay on its secure, PCI-DSS-compliant infrastructure. We store only transaction events and confirmations published to us by Razorpay, for record-keeping, reconciliation, and dispute-resolution purposes.

Subscription plans renew automatically at the end of each billing cycle at the then-applicable price, unless cancelled before the renewal date. You may cancel at any time; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period, and no further charges will be made thereafter. Your access to Paid Features will continue until the end of the period for which you have paid. Where required under applicable Reserve Bank of India regulations governing recurring payments, you will receive a pre-debit notification in advance of each recurring charge, and your express authentication will be obtained
where mandated.

Upon successful payment, Paid Features are typically unlocked within a few minutes. However, in certain cases including where connectivity issues arise between Razorpay and our backend systems confirmation of payment and unlocking of Paid Features may be delayed. Standard settlement timelines are 3 (three) to 5 (five) business days, and delays arising from banking-side or issuer-side issues may take longer. Where an amount has been debited from your account but the corresponding Paid Feature has not been unlocked, any auto-reversal of failed transactions will be carried out in accordance with the Reserve Bank of India’s framework on Harmonisation of Turn Around Time (TAT) for failed transactions. You may contact us at hey@equal.in with your transaction reference for assistance. We shall not be liable for delays caused solely by third-party payment processors or banking institutions, but we will make reasonable efforts to assist you in tracing and resolving any debited-but-unconfirmed transaction.

Given the instant-access, digital nature of the Paid Features, all payments are final and non-refundable, except in the following circumstances: (i) where a Paid Feature failed to unlock despite a successful and confirmed payment, and the issue cannot be resolved technically; (ii) where you have been charged more than once for the same transaction; or (iii) where a refund is required under applicable law. Approved refunds will be processed to your original payment method, through Razorpay, within 7 (seven) to 10 (ten) business days of approval. Cancellation of a subscription does not entitle you to a refund for the current or any prior billing period.

Paid Features that require an active unlock or subscription will remain inaccessible without the applicable payment. Where content is associated with your account, it is not deleted upon expiry of access; it becomes accessible again upon a valid purchase or resumption of an active subscription, subject to the data retention provisions of our Privacy Policy.

For iOS users:

All payments for the Equal AI iOS app and any Paid Features within it are processed exclusively through Apple’s In-App Purchase (“IAP”) system. We do not collect, store, or process any payment card or financial information directly; all such transactions are governed by Apple’s terms and conditions and are handled by Apple on its secure infrastructure. By making a purchase through Equal AI on iOS, you agree to Apple’s applicable terms and conditions.

Equal AI offers a 7 (seven) day free trial period for new subscribers. During the free trial, you will have full access to the Paid Features at no charge. At the time of initiating the free trial, Apple will ask you to confirm your subscription and payment method. Your payment method will be charged the applicable subscription amount automatically at the end of the 7-day free trial period unless you cancel at least 24 (twenty-four) hours before the trial period ends. To avoid being charged, you must cancel your subscription at least 24 (twenty-four) hours before the end of the free trial period. Cancellation instructions are set out in Section 3.4 below. Only one free trial is available per Apple ID. If you have previously subscribed to Equal AI using the same Apple ID, you may not be eligible for a free trial.

Your subscription to Equal AI will automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle at the subscription price displayed at the time of purchase, unless you cancel it at least 24 (twenty-four) hours before the end of the current billing period. Apple will charge your selected payment method through your Apple ID account on the renewal date. The subscription amount will be debited automatically at the beginning of each new billing cycle. You will receive a reminder from Apple before the renewal charge is processed, in accordance with Apple’s notification practices. We reserve the right to change the subscription price. If the price changes, Apple will notify you in advance and you will have the opportunity to cancel before the new price takes effect.

You may cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple ID account settings on your device. We do not manage subscription cancellations directly; all cancellations must be made through Apple. To avoid being charged for the next billing cycle, you must cancel at least 24 (twenty-four) hours before the end of the current billing period. Upon cancellation, your access to Paid Features will continue until the end of the billing period for which you have already paid. No further charges will be made after that date. Cancellation of your subscription does not entitle you to a refund for the current or any prior billing period.

All purchases made through Apple’s In-App Purchase system are subject to Apple’s refund policies. We do not process refunds directly for IAP transactions. If you believe you are entitled to a refund, you must submit a refund request directly to Apple through one of the following methods:

  • Visit reportaproblem.apple.com and sign in with your Apple ID.
  • Open the App Store app on your device, tap your profile icon, tap “Purchase History”, find the transaction, and follow the prompts to report a problem.

Apple will review your request in accordance with its own refund policies. We have no control over Apple’s refund decisions. For payment-related queries or concerns that are not covered by Apple’s refund process, you may contact us at hey@equal.in

All payments for the iOS version of Equal AI are processed by Apple Inc. through Apple’s In-App Purchase framework. Apple acts as the merchant of record for all IAP transactions. We receive only a confirmation of the transaction from Apple for the purposes of unlocking the relevant Paid Features. We do not have access to your complete card number, CVV, Apple Pay credentials, or any other payment details. Your use of Apple’s payment systems is governed by Apple’s terms and conditions, which you should review before making a purchase.

Upon successful payment confirmation from Apple, Paid Features are typically unlocked within a few minutes. In certain cases, including where there are connectivity issues between Apple’s systems and our backend, confirmation and unlocking may be delayed. If you experience such a delay, please contact us at hey@equal.in with your Apple transaction reference for assistance.

sections.body:

vii. promotes or relates to money laundering, gambling, terrorism, or any form of unlawful activity or behaviour that may cause incitement to commit a cognizable offense;

viii. is deceiving or misleading the addressee about the origin of the message or knowingly and intentionally communicates any information that is patently false or misleading in nature but may reasonably be perceived as a fact, or impersonates another person or misrepresents the origin of information;

ix. violates the norms of decency, public morality, or our community guidelines and user conduct expectations;

x. that threatens the unity, integrity, defence, security or sovereignty of India, friendly relations with foreign States, or public order, or causes incitement to the commission of any cognisable offence or prevents investigation of any offence or is insulting another nation;

xi. that contains software virus or any other computer code, file or program designed to interrupt, destroy or limit the functionality of any computer resource;

xii. that reverse engineers, decompiles, or attempts to extract the source code of our software; and

xiii. that use automated systems (bots, scripts) to access the Assistant in a manner that sends more request messages than a human could reasonably produce.

b. Use of AI Assistant for Call Handling: By using Equal AI, you agree to use the service in a lawful, responsible, and ethical manner. Equal AI is designed solely to receive inbound calls and assist you by answering, transcribing, and summarisingcalls using AI. You shall not misuse this feature to engage in or facilitate illegal, harmful, or deceptive activities such as follows:

i. Use Assistant-generated responses to harass or intimidate unknown callers.

ii. Use the Assistant to impersonate someone or misrepresent facts to callers.

iii. Use the Assistant to trick, manipulate, or phish callers for sensitive personal information such as OTPs, bank details, passwords.

iv. Enable the Assistant to respond with or generate vulgar, hateful, abusive, sexually explicit, paedophilic, or discriminatory responses.

v. Configure or allow the Assistant to respond to calls in ways that promote unlawful activities like hate speech, terrorism, unlawful organisations, or political manipulation.

c. In relation to the Assistant, you must not:

i. Use the Assistant in a way that could damage, disable, overburden, impair or compromise our systems or security or interfere with other users.

ii. Restrict or inhibit any other person from using the Assistant or any part thereof.

iii. Reproduce, modify, adapt, translate, create derivative works of, sell, rent, lease, loan, timeshare, distribute or otherwise exploit any portion of (or use any of) the Assistant except as expressly authorised herein, without our express prior written consent.

iv. Frame or mirror any portion of the Assistant, or otherwise incorporate any portion of any Assistant into any frame or service, without our express prior written consent.
